summary: New file with 4 scenarios. All 4 tests pass locally and full pytest suite remains green (566 passed). Code is well-commented, mocks are pinned to bound names per Task 11 convention, freezegun is used for time control. A few minor improvements identified.

findings.title: Use sqlite3.Row factory inline instead of accessing tuple by index
findings.description: Helper opens a raw sqlite3 connection and reads with default tuple cursor. The query selects only one column so r[0] is fine; just noting it for stylistic consistency with pending_articles_repo.list_pending() which uses dict-row.

findings.title: Magic UTC offset in scenario 1 comment
findings.description: Comment is correct (MSK is UTC+3) but a reader might miss why the test passes 09:00 UTC. The MSK constant is defined at module scope; using MSK.localize(...).astimezone(pytz.UTC) inside the freeze_time call would make the relationship explicit. Trivial.

findings.title: tearDown stops patchers manually instead of using addCleanup
findings.description: Modern unittest pattern uses self.addCleanup(patcher.stop) right after patcher.start(); on test failure during setUp this guarantees cleanup. The current tearDown is correct as long as setUp doesn't raise mid-stream — in this file the patchers are simple enough that the risk is low.
findings.recommendation: Acceptable. addCleanup would be a small refactor improvement but not required.

findings.title: Crash-loop guard sleep tolerance hardcoded ±5%
findings.description: Test asserts the guard sleep is within 5% of 1800s. Since freezegun freezes time absolutely, the elapsed delta should be exact (or within microseconds). The 5% slack is generous and gives a sane buffer for any time-zone or freeze-precision issue.

findings.title: Manual-review preemption test tolerates small false-positive: side_effect mutation triggers BEFORE Claude returns
findings.description: The mutation runs at the entry of slot 1's Claude call, not after. This is correct for the test purpose (mutation lands in DB before slot 2 runs list_pending), but the docstring at lines 552-556 says 'AFTER slot 1's row was selected by list_pending, but BEFORE slot 2's selection' — which is technically true because the bot already pulled o1 from list_pending into a Python list before the Claude call begins. Doc could be slightly clearer.
findings.recommendation: Docstring is acceptable. Mechanism is correct.

findings.title: Scenario 2 docstring overstates state-machine recovery coverage
findings.description: Test verifies advance to ping #1 and Google fallback for the slot-2 article, but does NOT verify recovery clears state on slot 3. The class-level comment at lines 360-365 already documents this: 'state machine does NOT auto-clear under current Wave 1-6 wiring' — so the test is intentionally relaxed. Test name 'recovers_on_next_slot' could mislead future readers; consider 'state_advances_and_continues_on_next_slot'.
findings.recommendation: Test name change would be cleaner but not required since the docstring + class-level comment already document the actual behaviour.

findings.title: Hard-coded telegraph URL in publish_article mock could shadow per-test URL needs
findings.description: All tests share 'https://telegra.ph/fake-page-04-27'. Scenario 4 uses a different URL for the operator path ('https://telegra.ph/operator-page'). Both URLs are distinct; test 4 already verifies the operator URL is preserved through move_to_published. Fine.
